description: Conformance matrix: decisions and no-dispatch expectations only. Runtime assertions require actual signed fixtures, trusted issuer configuration, resolver and protected resource.

decision_semantics.ALLOW: Verified identity, trusted principal binding and current action-specific authority; protected-resource execution may proceed
decision_semantics.PAUSE: Required authority status cannot be determined; incomplete_check; no dispatch

cases.name: valid binding and narrow delegation
cases.condition: Trusted issuer signed principal binding; expected agent DID proof; delegation valid for operation and audience; fresh status

cases.name: untrusted issuer
cases.condition: Identical fixture except issuer is not pretrusted for legal-identity claim

cases.name: self-asserted legal identity
cases.condition: Binding issuer is agent itself without independently accepted legal identity proof

cases.name: revoked principal binding
cases.condition: Authentic status confirms binding revoked

cases.name: expired binding
cases.condition: Binding validity ended before action

cases.name: wrong agent DID
cases.condition: Valid principal binding refers to different agent DID than signing actor

cases.name: binding without delegation
cases.condition: Valid binding but no signed grant for requested action

cases.name: wrong audience or action
cases.condition: Signed delegation permits a different resource or operation

cases.name: revoked delegation
cases.condition: Live authoritative status confirms delegated grant revoked

cases.name: unreachable authoritative status
cases.condition: Cannot establish required current status due to registry outage

cases.name: non-authoritative status source
cases.condition: Status response from registry not authorized for the binding/grant

cases.name: agent DID proof replay
cases.condition: Previously valid DID challenge response replayed with new request ID/nonce

cases.name: old principal after transfer
cases.condition: Principal ownership reassigned; legacy principal delegation used after verified transfer/revocation

cases.name: authorized key rotation
cases.condition: Verifier accepts DID method authorized key rotation; fresh challenge and revalidated binding semantics

cases.name: unproven key substitution
cases.condition: Attacker replaces agent key without authorized rotation

cases.name: unsupported assurance
cases.condition: Trusted issuer but credential assurance level below required legal-identity claim policy

cases.name: verified mutual ANP DID exchange plus accepted principal binding and delegation
cases.interface: ANP -> independent principal binding verifier -> NTI/ATP-compatible policy -> protected resource
cases.condition: verified mutual ANP DID exchange plus accepted principal binding and delegation

cases.name: valid ANP DID authentication without accepted legal principal binding
cases.interface: ANP -> independent principal binding verifier -> NTI/ATP-compatible policy -> protected resource
cases.condition: valid ANP DID authentication without accepted legal principal binding

cases.name: valid ANP mutual authentication and principal binding but no scoped delegation
cases.interface: ANP -> independent principal binding verifier -> NTI/ATP-compatible policy -> protected resource
cases.condition: valid ANP mutual authentication and principal binding but no scoped delegation

cases.name: ANP response DID proof mismatched to request ID or expected peer
cases.interface: ANP -> independent principal binding verifier -> NTI/ATP-compatible policy -> protected resource
cases.condition: ANP response DID proof mismatched to request ID or expected peer

cases.name: replayed ANP authentication or changed action digest
cases.interface: ANP -> independent principal binding verifier -> NTI/ATP-compatible policy -> protected resource
cases.condition: replayed ANP authentication or changed action digest

cases.name: valid ANP authentication but required binding status authority unreachable
cases.interface: ANP -> independent principal binding verifier -> NTI/ATP-compatible policy -> protected resource
cases.condition: valid ANP authentication but required binding status authority unreachable

cases.name: valid ANP authentication but delegation audience mismatches resource
cases.interface: ANP -> independent principal binding verifier -> NTI/ATP-compatible policy -> protected resource
cases.condition: valid ANP authentication but delegation audience mismatches resource

evidence_required: credential and proof bytes hashes with test-only keys
DID method and key resolution outcomes
credential and grant status source with verification timestamp
request ID, nonce, target resource, requested action
decision, reason, policy version, dispatch count
resource-confirmed outcome distinct from authorization decision
ANP expected-peer/request-response DID authentication proof verification and signed request digest/nonce/audience
disclaimer: These are proposed expectations, not executed integration tests or NTI certification.
